exposure: Laparoscopic excision of Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: The study included 43 patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who were referred to educational and medical centers of Isfahan University of Medical Science from 2021 to 2022.
finding: Laparoscopic excision of a Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) is an effective and feasible technique, offering the advantage of immediate myometrial reconstruction.
